import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
n=21
edges = [(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n)]
num_edges = len(edges)
edge_to_var = {e:k+1 for k,e in enumerate(edges)}
solver = Glucose3()
for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n),5):
    k5_edges = [tuple(sorted([a,b])) for a,b in itertools.combinations(combo,2)]
    clause = [edge_to_var[e] for e in k5_edges]
    solver.add_clause(clause)
for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n),4):
    k4_edges = [tuple(sorted([a,b])) for a,b in itertools.combinations(combo,2)]
    clause = [-edge_to_var[e] for e in k4_edges]
    solver.add_clause(clause)
print(solver.solve())
if solver.solve():
    model = solver.get_model()
    solution = [1 if x > 0 else 0 for x in model]
    print(solution)
    print(len(solution))
